classification.difficultyReason: Translate cumulative counts into quartile values by locating the observations crossing the 25th, 50th and 75th positions, then match the resulting summary to a box plot.

content.prompt:
The cumulative frequency graph shows the distribution of the number of movie downloads made by 100 people in one month.

Which box-plot best represents the same data as displayed in the cumulative frequency graph?

spec.description: Adjoining cumulative bars centred on downloads 2–9, a connecting cumulative curve, integer horizontal ticks, and horizontal grid lines every 10. Decorative stippling is omitted.
spec.mathematics: Bar boundaries are half-integers. Unlabelled heights and curve vertices reproduce approximate plotted positions: 17, 29, 35, 47, 66, 94, 99 and 100. These are drawing coordinates, not additional printed numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: All graph information is a permanent student-visible given.

spec.description: Unfilled box plot with option label A. and downloads axis labelled 2–9.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent multiple-choice option; no correctness indicator.

spec.description: Unfilled box plot with option label B. and downloads axis labelled 2–9.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent multiple-choice option; no correctness indicator.

spec.description: Unfilled box plot with option label C. and downloads axis labelled 2–9.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent multiple-choice option; no correctness indicator.

spec.description: Unfilled box plot with option label D. and downloads axis labelled 2–9.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent multiple-choice option; no correctness indicator.

answer.worked:
Median position $M_p=\frac{100+1}{2}=50.5$: the 50th and 51st values are both $6$. The cumulative histogram gives $Q_1=3$ and $Q_3=7$. Minimum $2$; maximum $9$ downloads.

The five-number summary is $(2,3,6,7,9)$, which matches option C.

Correct answer: C.
